Messages.Author: Eric Pettersen
Messages.Body:
Hi Jon,
Good to see you on the Net. I have two questions, the first you've
seen a lot:

1) Is Slaughtering the Herd a Dominate or Potence card? It's printed with
both symbols.

2) For purposes of the DCI's no repeat actions rule, if a minion is prevented
from even attempting a particular action with Direct Intervention, can
the minion attempt that action if a second copy of the DI'ed card is in
hand?

Thanks in advance.

Messages.Author: rag...@ugcs.caltech.edu
Messages.Body:
Some questions from the Sabbat set:

On setting range:
Who gets to set the range first? (I assume it is the acting vampire, but
I want to make sure.)

If range has been set, can it be set again?
For example, if Cailean is in combat with Angelica, and Cailean sets the
range to short, can Angelica now use Shadow Step to set the range to long?

How does set range interact with Immortal Grapple? For example, can Shadow
Step be used to set the range to long the second round of the Immortal
Grapple effect?
--
Robert Granat

Messages.Author: Jon Wilkie
Messages.Body:
In article <56fk7i$h...@gap.cco.caltech.edu>, rag...@ugcs.caltech.edu () wrote:

These ones I'll answer myself (although I get cold chills at the thought. :)

> On setting range:
> Who gets to set the range first? (I assume it is the acting vampire, but
> I want to make sure.)

The acting vampire.

> If range has been set, can it be set again?
> For example, if Cailean is in combat with Angelica, and Cailean sets the
> range to short, can Angelica now use Shadow Step to set the range to long?

Yep.

> How does set range interact with Immortal Grapple? For example, can Shadow
> Step be used to set the range to long the second round of the Immortal
> Grapple effect?

If Immortal Grapple was used at Superior, you skip the "determine range"
step. Therefore, Shadow Step could not push it to Long Range.
